public_health_question.v: Should all U.S. adults known or suspected to be unvaccinated or incompletely vaccinated against polio receive a primary IPV series?

ev.q: ACIP issued an IPV recommendation for all adults known or suspected to be unvaccinated or incompletely vaccinated against polio.
Use of Inactivated Polio Vaccine Among U.S. Adults: Updated Recommendations of the Advisory Committee on Immunization Practices
Updated Recommendations of the Advisory Committee on Immunization Practices — United States, 2023
Adults aged ≥18 years who are known or suspected to be unvaccinated or incompletely vaccinated against polio should complete a primary polio vaccination series
